task.population: The peso_lab-weighted complete-case adult distribution in the PNS 2013 laboratory-substudy release, not asserted to be nationally representative: baseline age 20–79, recorded sex 1/2, dictionary-admissible weight/height and final interview SBP/DBP, positive finite laboratory weight. Exclude reported baseline pregnancy; unknown/inapplicable pregnancy retained. No HbA1c, treatment or hypertension restriction. Generated equal-weight rows represent this defined analytical distribution under explicit transport assumptions. Baseline BP timing and unknown released final-reading aggregation must be retained as measurement limitations.

excluded_cohorts: From Published Evidence to Analyzable Biomedical Cohorts

model.population_interpretation: An assumed joint distribution conditional on the task's analytical eligibility criteria. Equal-weight draws represent the intended peso_lab-weighted complete-case population only under the stated transport assumptions; no target calibration is available.

bmi.law: Conditional shifted lognormal, truncated by rejection at fixed age and sex.

residual.law: Let R=sqrt(6*Beta(1,2)) and theta be independent Uniform(0,2*pi). Set Z=(R*cos(theta),R*sin(theta)), with covariance I. Apply the stated correlated BP loading and a common covariate-dependent scale g.

physiological_support.scale_rule: g is the minimum of 1 and each conditional-mean distance to a BP or pulse-pressure boundary divided by its maximum unscaled residual excursion. This defines the conditional error law; it is not post-generation clipping.
